For the most reliable translation and interpretation services, put your trust in American Education and Translation Services (AET). Our Boston top certified translation services cover more than 100 languages. AET has been in business for 10 years and has completed tens of thousands of translations and interpretation jobs during this time, which include many well-known institutions in greater Boston area. We are also a member of the American Translators Association (ATA), and follow the highest professional standards.

All of our prices are reasonable and competitive, so please contact us via phone / email today to get a free quote for your translation / interpretation project from our top interpreter services in Boston MA. We look forward to serving your needs and bridging the language gap.

What Types of Documents Do You Translate?

Our top certified translation service in Boston MA provides certified translations for all types of documents in more than 100 languages. No job is too big or too small for our professionals! The most common documents we work with are:

  • Transcripts
  • Diplomas
  • Birth certificates
  • Death certificates
  • Marriage licenses
  • Bank statements
  • Drivers’ licenses

Each complete certified translation set includes the copy of original document, the translated text, translator signature and a notarization. You can use these materials as soon as you receive them.

For more details, please refer to webpage: https://americantranslationservice.com/e_notarized.html

How Do Your Boston Top Interpreter Services Work?

If you need a verbal translation instead of a written one, you’ll find our Boston top interpreter services to be valuable. Our interpreters are professional, and fluent in many languages, allowing you to communicate effectively with those who speak English as a second language or don’t speak English at all. Rather than feeling stressed or intimidated, you and the other person can have a productive conversation with an interpreter. And we provide interpretation services through all popular methods: on site, phone, video conference.

Here is how our top interpreter services in Boston MA works:

  • Send us service inquiry via email or phone , the language you need, the method / duration / and date / location you prefer, and the number of translators required, etc.
  • We’ll contact you with a price, and once we receive payment, we can set up an appointment based on your preferred time and date.
  • The assigned interpreter will contact you before the appointment, collect info, and get fully prepared.
  • Most of our services are in Chinese, French, Spanish, Arabic, while covering more languages in Boston area.
